items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 14 at 12:59AM EST until November 15 at 6:00AM EST by NWS Mount Holly NJ
items.description:
* WHAT...Northwest winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and
seas 3 to 5 ft.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Great Egg Inlet to Cape May NJ out
20 NM, Coastal waters from Cape May NJ to Cape Henlopen DE out
20 NM and Coastal waters from Cape Henlopen to Fenwick Island
DE out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 6 AM EST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
